rationale: Water damage to the policyholder's own basement, flooring, drywall, and contents caused by the policyholder's plumbing failure is direct property damage to their insured home and personal property.
claim_summary: Sam Patel's basement flooded due to a failure in his own plumbing, resulting in two inches of standing water across the entire basement. Hardwood flooring is buckled, drywall is soaked up to one foot high, and stored boxes are ruined. This high-severity claim (estimated damage exceeding $25,000) requires urgent adjuster assessment and mitigation to prevent mold and further damage.

case_facts.description: two inches of water across entire basement, hardwood floor buckled, drywall soaked to one foot high, stored boxes ruined

rationale: Wind damage to roof shingles on the policyholder's own residential structure is direct property damage to the home itself.
claim_summary: Wind damage to roof shingles on back porch overhang; four shingles blown off last weekend with no interior water damage or secondary loss. Estimated repair cost $400.

case_facts.description: four shingles blown off by wind, no interior water damage
